name: TPG Mortgage Investment Trust (MITT)
teaser: MITT fell through the old $5.25 buy price after a 7.3% book value drop. The new buy price is $3.93.
llms: Residential mortgage credit REIT (non-agency and home equity loans, securitized) merging with Cherry Hill. Valued on sustainable earnings of the common equity over a 13% cost of equity on pro forma book value of $8.64, with a price to book cross-check. Book value fell 7.3% to $9.27 in Q3 2026 and distributable earnings of $0.21 did not cover the $0.24 dividend. The price implies a 6.9% return on equity. Bear $3.59, Base $6.84, Bull $9.08. Verdict HOLD at $4.56, maximum buy price $3.93 (update of the September 21, 2026 analysis).
